title: Add VPC control plane Terraform module: multi-AZ subnets, interface endpoints, SGs, peering, Route53
author: Sara Chen
description: Adds a reusable Terraform module and example for provisioning the VPC control plane used by Redwood Private. Motivation: customers installing Private often require a repeatable, secure VPC layout (multi-AZ subnets, interface endpoints for S3/SSM/EC2/STS, security groups scoped for control-plane <-> data-plane, VPC peering for customer networks, and Route53 private hosted zone setup for control-plane DNS). This PR introduces a new module terraform/modules/vpc-control-plane plus an example in examples/private/vpc-control-plane. It includes variables for AZ selection, subnet CIDR allocations, interface endpoint toggles, security group rules (pluggable CIDR lists), peering configuration (auto-create or reference existing), and automated Route53 inbound/outbound rules for cross-account peering. Changes also update docs/docs/private/vpc-setup.md with a step-by-step guide, a helm chart note for private deployment values, and an acceptance test. Checklist: - [x] Core Terraform module and outputs - [x] Parameters and defaults for multi-AZ deploys - [x] Interface endpoints for S3, EC2, STS, SecretsManager, KMS (toggleable) - [x] Security groups with least-privilege rules and explanation in docs - [x] VPC peering automation with optional route propagation and cleanup - [x] Route53 private hosted zone delegation and examples for cross-account DNS - [x] Example private deployment that wires control plane to a sample data-plane VPC - [x] Unit/integration tests for main flows - [x] CHANGELOG/release notes entry Notes on backward compatibility: this is additive. Existing private-installer flows remain unchanged unless users opt into the new module. Security review: defaults minimize open CIDR ranges; reviewers should audit SG rules for managed services. Related: ENG-5121 (private-vpc-redesign), SUP-887 (customer support request for automated peering), ENG-5233 (dns-delegation).

release_notes: Add new terraform module terraform/modules/vpc-control-plane to support multi-AZ control plane provisioning (subnets, interface endpoints, security groups, optional VPC peering, and Route53 private DNS delegation). Includes examples and docs. Backwards compatible and opt-in.
notes: Deployment note: customers using the existing private-installer should be able to adopt this module incrementally. For peering across accounts, customers must provide correct role/permissions for acceptance tests. The module surfaces a minimal set of outputs (vpc_id, private_hosted_zone_id, route_table_ids, peering_connection_id) for downstream wiring.

merge_notes: Squash-merged after approvals from Ethan, Miguel, Lina. CI green, terratest passing in sandbox. Release notes added to CHANGELOG under Unreleased -> infra.
security_review: Conducted basic security review; defaults enforce minimal open CIDR, endpoints toggled off unless explicitly enabled. Recommended follow-up: formal security audit for cross-account peering patterns before rolling out to enterprise customers.
testing: Includes terratest-based acceptance test test/terraform/acceptance/vpc_control_plane_test.go which provisions module in a sandbox AWS account, asserts endpoints and SGs, validates peering import and Route53 delegation with retries.
how_to_release: Add entry to changelog and cut a patch release for terraform modules. Notify private-installer maintainers to add opt-in wiring. No changes required in hosted API.
